title: Modular Neural Decoder for Surface Code Memory and Logic on Superconducting Processors
summary: Neural decoders for quantum error correction have achieved high accuracy on surface code memory experiments, but practical fault-tolerant computation requires decoders that transfer across devices, noise conditions, and logical operations. We introduce a modular graph-recurrent decoder designed for this setting. Built from reusable local syndrome encoders, it is pretrained in simulation and fine-tuned to hardware using a common pipeline, with only lightweight spatial aggregation adapted between experiments.
